description: Inventory for scripts/verify-*.mjs and scripts/audit-*.mjs. 'wired' means an automatic GitHub Actions or CircleCI invocation; 'manual' means an explicit package command or workflow_dispatch-only workflow; 'chained' means reached through another maintained script/test, including the manual verification dispatcher; and 'orphan' means there is no maintained entry point. Orphan verification scripts are not allowed. Automatic wired scripts must pass unless their environment dependency is declared. knownFailing is allowed only for manual checks, and stale exceptions fail.

environmentDependent.verify-server-bundle.mjs: Reads dist/ — requires npm run build.
environmentDependent.verify-runtime-dependencies.mjs: Reads esbuild's metafile from dist/ — requires npm run build.
environmentDependent.verify-dependency-audit.mjs: Runs npm audit, which needs registry access.
environmentDependent.verify-ci-disposable-schema.mjs: Provisions and drops a throwaway database.
environmentDependent.verify-sp-migration-rehearsal.mjs: Executes a migration rehearsal against a database.
environmentDependent.verify-database-backup.mjs: Exercises backup and restore against a database.
environmentDependent.verify-memory-stabilization.mjs: Measures runtime memory against a running server.
environmentDependent.audit-coverage-ratchet.mjs: Reads coverage/ — requires a coverage run.
environmentDependent.audit-lint-warnings.mjs: Reads artifacts/lint/eslint-report.json — requires npm run lint.
environmentDependent.audit-god-file-boundaries.mjs: Reports reviewed growth allowances as failures; the gate is tests/god-file-boundaries.test.ts, which consults config/ci-ratchet-allowances.json.
environmentDependent.verify-startup-migrations.mjs: Reads /api/health/db from a running application — requires npm run build and a started server against a provisioned database.
Drives a real browser against a running deployment — requires ERP_SMOKE_USERNAME/ERP_SMOKE_PASSWORD and a reachable ERP_SMOKE_BASE_URL.

environmentDependent.verify-mobile-responsive-wave3-browser.m: Drives a real browser against a running deployment — requires ERP_SMOKE_USERNAME/ERP_SMOKE_PASSWORD and a reachable ERP_SMOKE_BASE_URL.
environmentDependent.verify-mobile-responsive-wave4-browser.m: Drives a real browser against a running deployment — requires ERP_SMOKE_USERNAME/ERP_SMOKE_PASSWORD and a reachable ERP_SMOKE_BASE_URL.
environmentDependent.verify-remote-support-rollout-metrics.mj: Polls remote-support rollout metrics from a running deployment — requires REMOTE_SUPPORT_GATE_BASE_URL/REMOTE_SUPPORT_GATE_USERNAME/REMOTE_SUPPORT_GATE_PASSWORD. The gate itself still fails loudly in .github/workflows/remote-support-rollout-e2e.yml, where those secrets are provided.
